scientific_claim: Full-wave observations can exclude specified translated material classes over every discrete centre under independent per-cell weak exterior uncertainty. Class localization, contrast intervals, and unrestricted one-cell peaks are distinct queries.

model.polarization: 2D scalar TM, exp(-i omega t), pulse-cell equal-area disk
model.austria_shape: an annulus and two elevated disks
model.centre_contract: Every integer raster centre. Shift the declared pixel-centred pattern and truncate it to the in-domain cells. No minimum retained support fraction. Each pattern has nonempty in-domain support at every centre. Coordinates are zero-indexed x,y.

material_classes.shape_profile: One material coordinate per cell, independently variable; profile-weighted intervals on all nonzero footprint cells. A margin shell has weight 0.50. Exterior, including holes, is independently bounded by the declared b.
